note: Pitcairn, Henderson, Ducie and Oeno Islands, read in the laws the Government of the Pitcairn Islands publishes at government.pn/laws (74 titles, the revised editions and later ordinances), 2026-10-31. Majority: no ordinance sets the age of majority or a minor's capacity; the Children Ordinance (Cap. 41, revised edition 2014), s. 2, calls a child a person under 18, and the Interpretation and General Clauses Ordinance (Cap. 1, 2017 revised edition) defines the common law as England's and applied Acts as the UK Acts in force in the Islands, but the provision that would bring England's Family Law Reform Act 1969 in wasn't found in the Judicature (Courts), Justice or Interpretation ordinances, so majority is null. Work: no employment ordinance is among the islands' laws (the Trade Unions and Trade Disputes Ordinance is the only labour law listed), so no age was found and work is null. Service: no law of military or national service is among them, so service is none (a reading from absence).
